unit: Final cumulative RUN19 A/B/C source and full stored evidence package
identity_scope: Local ZIP payload byte/mode identity and CRC only; archived scientific records retain their narrower producer status.

Git_vs_archive.Git_selection: Source, Cargo/lock, documentation, focused test records, summaries, relevant JSON manifests and small SVG. Earlier A/C source and delivery metadata are inherited.
Git_vs_archive.full_archive_only: All stored raw CSV/gzip, binary tables including negative-control cache, PNG/PDF, exact executed ELF files and complete vendor source are also retained in the archive. They are not all Git blobs in the source commit.
Git_vs_archive.existing_source_closure: Original native91 at RUN13, the unchanged VigilODE directed.rs and LICENSE, root LICENSE and original RUN16 DAG45/26 snapshots are copied at exact repository-relative paths.
Git_vs_archive.manifest_semantics: ARCHIVE_MANIFEST binds byte size, SHA256 and POSIX mode for every payload file, excluding itself. Historical producer manifests, failure records and narrower scientific statuses remain unchanged.
Git_vs_archive.no_inference: A matching archive hash does not establish physical model validity, numerical convergence or byte-identical future compilation.
Git_vs_archive.known_non_science_Git_byte_variants: The original local A/C delivery JSON each contain one additional trailing LF relative to actual remote Git bytes. Both local and remote originals plus their semantic-equality addendum are preserved under their explicit paths; source/scientific result bytes are not changed.

backup_locations: Root records actual cloud locations and readback checks after upload in separate delivery metadata.
